critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: logger is defined AFTER seed_projects() uses it in @app.on_event('startup'). If seed path runs before logging.basicConfig line executes at import time it could NameError. In practice logger is defined at module import before startup fires so it works, but declaration order is fragile — move logging setup above route/seed definitions.

backend/server.py: CORS uses os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS','*').split(',') combined with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject '*' with credentials. Currently frontend uses Bearer token in localStorage so this is not exercised, but should be tightened.
server.py has ~500 lines with routes+models+seed in one file — consider splitting for maintainability if it grows.
PUT /api/admin/about: response includes MongoDB _id if fetched from db (not here — returns local dict, fine). Good.
compress_image swallows all exceptions silently; would benefit from at least logging.
